product_name: Everyday Shirt in Silky Cotton | Light Blue
retrieval: Firecrawl interact hosted Node fetch, raw bytes returned base64 then independently SHA256 checked locally

official_details.description: Classic collar, button placket and sleeve cuff, modern shirttail hem, gentle cocoon shape, oversized fit

inspection.pose: full body; near-frontal asymmetric stance with one hand in trouser pocket and elbow bent, other arm lowered; visible shoulder line but one wrist/palm is occluded
inspection.garment: open light-blue long-sleeve loose shirt, sleeves rolled/pushed to forearm; white inner top, black wide-leg trousers and belt
inspection.limits: occluded hand cannot be a visible-wrist target; oversized shirt not naked-body silhouette; inner top is separate garment
